violations.why: Timer_C (prio 4) can preempt the increment in Timer_A, and its write is lost.
Timer_C can overwrite timerCount between A's increment and its check.
Timer_C's write can land between A's two reads, so they see different values.
Timer_Force (prio 3) can preempt the read-modify-write in Timer_A, and its increment is lost.
Timer_Force can change timerCount between A's increment and its check.
Timer_Force's write can land between A's two reads.
Timer_Reset (prio 5) can preempt the increment in Timer_A and its reset is lost.
Timer_Reset can zero timerCount between A's increment and its check.
Timer_Reset's write can land between A's two reads.
Timer_C can overwrite the value Timer_B just wrote before Timer_B reads it back.
Timer_Force's increment can land between Timer_B's write and its check.
Timer_Reset can zero timerCount between Timer_B's write and its check.
Timer_Reset can zero timerCount between Timer_C's write and its check.
Timer_C (prio 4) can preempt Timer_Force's increment and its write is lost.
Timer_Reset can preempt Timer_Force's increment and its reset is lost.
